next.reason: 1985 READ GR11: AT END ignored; FPI set and status updated; a non-at-end exception transfers control per the USE rules after any USE procedure; else record made available, INTO move, then end of READ or NOT AT END. §2023:14.9.30.4 GR13 restates all three actions ('the AT END phrase or the INVALID KEY phrase is ignored, if specified'; other exceptions per 9.1.12; else record, INTO move, imperative-statement-2); §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 states the return after a USE procedure. The record-operation-conflict proviso concerns locking, absent from 1985.
